name: How can I reduce the risk of change orders during construction?

mainEntity.name: How can I reduce the risk of change orders during construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Invest in thorough planning, detailed drawings, and early selections for fixtures and finishes; clear scope definition and contingency budgeting also help absorb necessary changes without derailing the project.
